What is your opinion of victimless crime(s)?

My opinion varies for each crime committed.

For prostitution, that's their ultimate choice and their risk to bare, assuming the prostitution is voluntary by both parties.

For drug use, I don't think it deserves life in prison. I also don't think it deserves to get off with a $20 ticket. (Depends on the drug)

For trespassing, I understand it. It's someone's property and if they don't want you there then you shouldn't be there. On the other hand, if you're not destroying the place or doing something else illegal, then what's the harm?

Suicide, well how exactly are you going to jail someone when they're dead? (I don't think it should be illegal)

Gambling: Kind of has a victim if you count the tax payers having to pay for gambling addicts that blow all of their money and can no longer pay for themselves to eat.

Like I said, many crimes, many opinions.

I think it's interesting that you think of trespassing as victimless.

If you don't protect your property rights, eventually you lose them. For example, if people cross your land frequently enough to cause a trail to be formed, you can lose the right to keep them off. A judge may rule you have granted an easement, and that other people now have a right to cross your property.

I don't think it's victimless in certain scenarios. When I was typing this the scenario in my head was an abandoned warehouse.

I completely agree with trespassing laws when it comes to someone's home, a business, etc.

Strange how you see the posession/use of drugs as victimless, but not gambling -- even though both require tax-supported rehab centers.

I'm right there with you no suicide.

And I'm on the other side of the fence for trespassing -- no pun intended. You get people who would skirt the law, possibly stalking others, by just standing on their lawn every night... Everyone deserves to feel safe on their own property, and should be able to have a say who can and cannot be there.

If I were to take into account every scenario i'm sure I'd think differently. Again, as with my trespassing opinion, I used one scenario:

For trespassing I was thinking about an abandoned property.

For "drugs" I was thinking Marijuana, which is something that should be legalized and at this point is a victimless crime.

As for stronger drugs there are definitely victims, but only if they go to rehab.

not something i put much thought into, but off the top of my head my sentiment is, no victim, no crime, but i think that, for me, that assumes some degree of personal responsibility toward how we treat others and the environment and it certainly depends on what you include in "victim" because animals, the earth, etc., can all be victimized
